messages.content: Write a PRD for offline note export from this product need.

cases.judge: The PRD must remain solution-agnostic while containing traceable concise user stories, observable acceptance criteria, and the complete product sections.

messages.content: Refine this PRD while preserving unresolved product decisions.

Reconstruct a PRD from these existing user stories supplied as identifiers and text. STORY-41: As warehouse staff, I want to scan an item so that inventory is updated; acceptance says invalid codes show an error. STORY-42: As a supervisor, I want an audit view so that discrepancies can be investigated. Use them as source evidence. Do not create, edit, estimate, or prioritize the backlog.

cases.judge: The response must accept the supplied story identifiers and inline text as valid PRD source evidence, preserve traceability from each story to product outcomes, requirements, acceptance evidence, dependencies, or open questions, and reconstruct only supported product context. It must consume the stories read-only without creating, editing, estimating, prioritizing, transitioning, or synchronizing backlog items.
must_not: reject stories as the wrong input

messages.content: Create one PRD for this accepted product scope containing 12 goals, 24 requirements, 24 concise user stories, 24 acceptance criteria, 13 dependencies, and 12 open questions. Use continuation batches and omit nothing.

cases.judge: The continuation ledger must account for every accepted item across bounded batches, preserve traceability from goals to requirements to stories and acceptance criteria, and never silently cap the PRD at the first batch.

cases.judge: A detailed estimated backlog request must not trigger PRD authoring even though a PRD can contain concise unestimated user stories.
